cases.title: Search Title filters the event list
steps: Enter a distinctive part of the identified event title.
Wait for the list to refresh.
cases.expected: The list shows matching event titles and excludes events that do not match the entered text.
cases.setup: Open /orders with "Live 8583" selected and identify a visible event title.
gaps: Identify a currently visible event title, extract a distinctive fragment, and pass that dynamic value into fill; remember has no supported value substitution.
Assert that the refreshed list contains matching titles and excludes all nonmatching events for the dynamically identified search text.
Assert the exact Live count of 8583 without an unconfirmed control label; filter_events selects Live independently of its count.
